reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, post-fix stale re-review batch 2, 2026-08-02

samples_reviewed.question_text: What number comes next when counting: 306, 307, 308, 309, ___?
Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 538, 537, 540, 539
The dot is at 3 and it moves forward 1 number. Starting from 3, just count up 1 number. Which number will the dot land on?
The two parts are 1 and 12. What is the sum?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Only seed 51 ('The dot is at 3 and it moves forward 1 number... land on?') shows counting up on a number line; seed 42 ('What is 15 + 10?') and seed 82 ('Dante says: 2 + 2 = 4') are bare facts with no counting-up or number-line framing at all.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The competency's core sub-case, counting up on a number line, renders in only 1 of 10 samples (seed 51); the other 9 substitute bare addition facts, an unrelated sequence ('446, 447, 448, 449, ___') and unrelated ordering ('538, 537, 540, 539').

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Sentence structure is simple grade-2 reading level, but seed 44 and seed 45 demand recognizing a hundreds-boundary crossing (449 to 450, 309 to 310), a heavier reasoning step than the 'counting up' by a single digit the competency names.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formatter names vary (mcq, cloze, ordering, true_false) but the substantive variation is spent on off-topic sequence and ordering tasks like 'Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 538, 537, 540, 539' rather than counting-up variants.

competency_alignment.rationale: Seeds 44, 45 and 50 build 3-digit sequencing/ordering skill ('306, 307, 308, 309, ___' and '538, 537, 540, 539'), an axis unrelated to illustrating 2-digit-plus-1-digit addition as counting up on a number line.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The competency specifies 2-digit and 1-digit addends, yet seed 43 uses two 1-digit addends ('What is 1 + 3?') and seeds 44/45/50 use 3-digit numbers (446-450, 306-310, 538-540) entirely outside the addition-fact scope.
